articles.title: BTS withdraw from Grammys, a month after Asian pop prize introduced - BBC
articles.description: All seven members of the band post a statement online, saying they will boycott the 2027 ceremony.
articles.content: By choosing to mention both region and language in their statement, the members of BTS - RM, Jimin, V, Suga, Jungkook, Jin and J-Hope - appeared to reflect that concern.
